ios.desc:
Ever wondered what the insides of your favorite gadgets look like? 

See if you can guess what product we've torn down in this multiple choice electronics guessing game!

How it works:

You’ll see a close-up image of the inner circuit board of a real-world digital device. 
Your job? 
Pick the correct product from four options. Guess right to move on. Guess wrong? Well, you'll learn something new anyway.

What’s inside:

Season 1 (Free): 5 games to get your brain buzzing.
Season 2 (One-time purchase): Unlock 20 more challenging teardowns. No ads. No subscriptions. Just pure techy fun.

Perfect for:

- Hardware geeks
- Engineers-in-the-making
- Puzzle and trivia lovers
- Anyone who’s ever opened a remote control just to see what’s inside
- Get ready to tear things down – without the screwdriver.

show_hn.title: Show HN: A teardown electronics quiz app made by me and a friend Ive never met

quotes.text:
I found a partly broken electronic doorbell on the ground and realized I never would have guessed that this was a doorbell. So I posted in my sideproject community (relentlessly.no) an idea to make a quiz app where we break open many gadgets, take pictures and let people guess what gadgets they are! Ive been working on and off for about three months on this with a fullstack and a designer that i met in our sideproject community <3 We know its pretty basic but would love to see if anyone finds it interesting. there are like five free tasks before a 3 usd season 1

Whats crazy is two things: Ive never met the designer. And we didnt have ONE single meeting digitally or physically while making this. all asynchronous work through slack. Man I LOVE that. And now i own 33% of a basic app. Time of my life!
